News App documentation¶

News App is a Django news platform where journalists write articles and newsletters, editors review and approve them, and readers subscribe to the publishers and journalists they follow. Approved articles are emailed to subscribers and exposed through a REST API.

User roles¶

Every account has exactly one role:

  • Reader - reads approved articles and newsletters, and subscribes to publishers and journalists.

  • Journalist - writes articles and newsletters, and can edit or delete only their own work.

  • Editor - reviews and approves articles, edits or deletes any article or newsletter, and manages publishers.

Each role maps to a Django group with matching model permissions, so access is checked with user.has_perm(...) throughout the project.

Getting started¶

See README.md in the project root for how to install and run the app with a virtual environment or with Docker.
